## Changes

- Remove TorBox per-torrent seeder probes from source discovery. Keep the fast batched cache check and provider seeder counts so titles open sooner.
- Preserve a season torrent's episode file index and filename through source selection, fixing playback requests for episodes other than the first file.
- Add background, best-effort ALASS subtitle alignment for external timed subtitles. It uses bounded low-resolution audio probing, applies only a confident offset, and leaves manual delay available. Automatically calculated offsets are not saved as manual preferences.

## Verification And Limitations

Local Android unit tests, release lint, Rust unit tests, and the signed 32-bit APK build passed. The APK uses the existing release certificate. Physical TV playback and live TorBox responses still need on-device verification. Subtitle alignment is a guarded constant-offset match, not a guarantee for edited cuts, drift, unsupported subtitle formats, or streams that cannot be probed safely.
